blurb: Guests drive through a 2-mile safari to see animals in a natural setting, with animals coming directly to vehicles for photos. Admission includes unlimited drive-through access and entry to the Safari Walkabout, Tortoise Lane, Petting Zoo, and Budgie Experiences. The safari duration can be as short as 45 minutes or as long as guests like until closing.
